risk_note: RV2 (content agreement reads). content/index.ts exports createAgreementReader({db}).currentAgreement(appId, type): one indexed query for the highest version of (app_id, type), uncached, usable with a caller's transaction handle; returns version, min_version, resign_from_version (F1-02m resignFromVersion), text_url (the stored url column), text_sha256, published_at, or null without a row. agreementTextUrl builds the H5 agreement page address from an https base (used by the F1-02p publish). GET /v1/agreements (anonymous, getAgreements leaves planned) returns the current privacy and agreement versions (labor agreement excluded), cached 60 s per app_id on the injected clock; without a database it answers 50001. identity is unchanged (switching B1-13h to the port is a later task). Rule test #10 was mechanically fixed by the orchestrator before the implementation: x-auth none operations never read Authorization, so a deletion_only token gets the anonymous 200 (L31 corrected). No funds. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
